stories.title: Trump wil nog niet bevestigen of er een livestream komt van omstreden executie

en.title: Trump will not yet confirm whether there will be a livestream of controversial execution
en.summary: President Trump declined to confirm Friday whether a planned livestream of Nidal Hasan's execution will proceed, stating that a decision on the matter remains pending.

stories.title: Veel materiële schade door zware aardbeving in Panama, tsunami-waarschuwing ingetrokken

en.title: Significant material damage from severe earthquake in Panama, tsunami warning withdrawn
en.summary: A strong earthquake struck Panama causing substantial material damage, though authorities later withdrew the accompanying tsunami warning.

stories.title: Geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting bij spoorbrug

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson at railroad bridge
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus stations was suspended following a fire at a railroad bridge caused by arson.

stories.title: Geen treinverkeer op spoor tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting

en.title: No train traffic on track between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson
en.summary: A fire at a railroad bridge halted train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus throughout Saturday, with authorities finding no immediate connection to recent rail sabotage incidents.

stories.title: Brandstichting bij het spoor, geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft

en.title: Arson at railway, no trains between Rotterdam and Delft
en.summary: A fire was deliberately set at a railway bridge near Rotterdam-Delfshaven overnight, causing train services between Rotterdam Central and Delft Campus to be suspended for the remainder of the day. Authorities suspect sabotage.

stories.title: Kritiek op executie via livestream, Trump zegt dat besluit nog niet vaststaat

en.title: Criticism over execution via livestream, Trump says decision not yet final
en.summary: U.S. President Trump stated that the decision to livestream the execution of an American military member has not been finalized, following criticism of an announcement by Defense Secretary Hegseth. Trump indicated the execution would proceed by firing squad.

stories.title: Hele dag geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting bij spoor

en.title: All day no trains between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson at railway
en.summary: Train services between Rotterdam and Delft are suspended on Saturday following arson at the Delfshaven railway bridge, with disruptions expected to continue until the end of regular service hours.

stories.title: PSV overtuigt niet bij herstart eredivisie, maar wint wel van Heerenveen (2-0)

en.title: PSV unconvincing in Eredivisie restart but beats Heerenveen (2-0)
en.summary: PSV won 2-0 against Heerenveen in the Eredivisie restart despite an unconvincing performance.

stories.title: Emiraten bevestigen dat Flydubai-piloot aanslag wilde plegen op vliegveld Tel Aviv

en.title: Emirates confirm Flydubai pilot wanted to carry out attack on Tel Aviv airport
en.summary: The United Arab Emirates have confirmed that a Flydubai pilot intended to conduct an attack at Tel Aviv airport.

stories.title: Nederland geeft diamant en zwaard terug aan Indonesië: ‘Ze hadden nooit in Nederland moeten zijn’

en.title: Netherlands returns diamond and sword to Indonesia: 'They should never have been in the Netherlands'
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning cultural artifacts including a diamond and sword to Indonesia, items that were improperly taken during the colonial period.

stories.title: Nederland geeft eeuwenoude koran en kostbare diamant terug aan Indonesië

en.title: Netherlands returns centuries-old Quran and valuable diamond to Indonesia
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning twenty cultural objects to Indonesia, including a 36-carat diamond, a handwritten Quran, and a traditional sword, all taken during the colonial era.

stories.title: Nederland geeft geroofde ‘diamant van Banjarmasin’ terug aan Indonesië

en.title: Netherlands returns looted 'Banjarmasin diamond' to Indonesia
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning the Banjarmasin diamond along with nineteen other objects, including a handwritten Quran, to Indonesia following advice from the Commission on Colonial Collections. The Culture Minister stated these objects should never have been in the Netherlands.
